senses.zh_definition: 专名拼写 Yoo，可见于韩国人名的拉丁字母写法，例如 Gong Yoo（孔刘）；仅凭小写 yoo 无法确定具体人物或原文。
senses.en_definition: A spelling used in romanized Korean personal names, as in Gong Yoo; the isolated token does not identify a particular person.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan yang digunakan dalam nama orang Korea yang ditulis dengan huruf Rumi, misalnya Gong Yoo; rujukannya bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 此处只收录有来源支持的人名用法，不据此认定 yoo 是正式马来语词或固定口语感叹词。马来语释义为编辑说明，并非 DBP 引文。以下为名称组合及教学例句，不代表已核实的高频搭配。[韩国电影振兴委员会人物资料](https://www.koreanfilm.or.kr/eng/films/index/peopleView.jsp?peopleCd=10001901)

dual_scenarios.ms: Gong Yoo merupakan antara pelakon yang membintangi filem Train to Busan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 孔刘是电影《釜山行》的主演之一。
dual_scenarios.en: Gong Yoo is one of the actors starring in Train to Busan.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau dah tengok filem Gong Yoo tu?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah menonton filem lakonan Gong Yoo itu?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你看过孔刘那部电影了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Have you seen that Gong Yoo movie yet?

etymology.historical_story: Names can enter Malay texts without becoming Malay vocabulary. The Korean Film Council records the actor’s name as Gong Yoo, providing an identifiable example of this spelling. However, the packet supplies neither an original Korean spelling nor a source sentence, so the isolated token cannot establish a particular surname, Chinese character, or etymological meaning. [Korean Film Council](https://www.koreanfilm.or.kr/eng/films/index/peopleView.jsp?peopleCd=10001901)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Yoo 连同 Gong Yoo（孔刘）一起记：先认人名，再看上下文；不要硬配普通词义。
